description_en: Updates the information of a specified member in an organization
description_zh: 更新组织下指定成员的信息
name: UpdateUser

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to update. This user ID is the Quick BI UserID, not the Alibaba Cloud UID
parameters.help_zh: 待更新的用户ID。此处的用户ID为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to assign the organization administrator role. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No.

<notice>This parameter is deprecated. When RoleIds is specified, this parameter does not take effect.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否赋予组织管理员角色。取值范围：

true：是
false：否

<notice>参数已过期不推荐使用，当传入RoleIds 时该参数无效。</notice>
parameters.name: admin_user

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to assign the organization permission management administrator role. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No.

<notice>This parameter has expired and is not recommended. When RoleIds is specified, this parameter does not take effect.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否赋予组织权限管理员角色。取值范围：

true：是
false：否

<notice>参数已过期不推荐使用，当传入RoleIds 时该参数无效。</notice>
parameters.name: auth_admin_user

parameters.help_en:
The user type of the organization member. Valid values:

1: Developer.
2: Visitor.
3: Analyst
parameters.help_zh:
组织成员的用户类型。取值范围：

1 ：开发者
2 ：访问者
3 ：分析师
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en:
The nickname.

Format check: The maximum length is 50 characters.
Special format check: Chinese characters, English characters, digits, _ \ / | () ] [
parameters.help_zh:
昵称。

格式检查：最大长度50个字符。
特殊格式校验：中英文数字 _ \ / | () ] [
parameters.name: nick_name

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of preset or custom organization roles to attach to the user, separated by commas (,). A maximum of three role IDs are supported. Valid values:
Organization administrator (preset role): 111111111
Permission management administrator (preset role): 111111112
Common user (preset role): 111111113
parameters.help_zh:
用户绑定的预置或自定义组织角色ID，用英文逗号“,”分割，最多3个。取值范围：
组织管理员（预置角色）：111111111
权限管理员（预置角色）：111111112
普通用户（预置角色）：111111113
parameters.name: role_ids

parameters.help_en:
The user status. Valid values:
false: Activated.
true: Deactivated
parameters.help_zh:
用户状态：
false：激活
true：失效
parameters.name: is_deleted

parameters.help_en:
The intelligent module quota modification information.

Pass the parameter as a JSON array. Each array element contains the following fields:

moduleType -- The intelligent module.
smartQAskNum -- Smart Q questions.
smartQDevNum -- Smart Q building.
qreport -- Smart Q reports.
qExploreNum -- Smart Q exploration edition.

status -- Specifies whether to enable the module.

0 -- Revoke authorization.
1 -- Grant authorization
parameters.help_zh:
智能化模块配额修改信息。

传参以 json 数组方式，每个数组内容如下

moduleType -- 智能化模块
smartQAskNum -- 小 Q 问数
smartQDevNum -- 小 Q 搭建
qreport -- 小 Q 报告
qExploreNum -- 小 Q 探索版

status -- 是否开启

0 -- 取消授权
1 -- 授权
parameters.name: copilot_modules

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the operation. Valid values:

true: Successful.
false: Failed
Result.description_zh:
返回接口执行结果。取值范围：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
